method: Read-only GET requests to the public WooCommerce Store API, plus /wp-json/wp/v2/product to find published products hidden from the list, plus each public product page for a cross-check. Nothing was modified.
notes: Prices: Store API gives minor units (cents); converted to dollars CAD here. sale_price is set only when on_sale is true (the API repeats the regular price in sale_price when nothing is on sale).
Every listing is a WooCommerce "simple" product: each size is its own listing, there are no variations.

short_description_text = what a shopper sees. The stored short-description HTML also contains pasted theme tab panels marked hidden (shipping, returns, review and Q&A widgets); that fuller text is kept in short_description_text_incl_hidden_panels and is what the site puts into its meta description and Product schema.

long_description_text = the WooCommerce long description (post content). The theme does not show it on product pages (verified: placeholder text absent from every page), but it is public through the Store API.
Stock: the store does not publish quantities; only in/out of stock.
Audit = first-pass flags against .claude/skills/peptide-regulatory (wording-rules.md B). Risk scan, not legal advice. Nothing rewritten.
